page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for heavy computational workloads. It features 48 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors running at 2.0 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 960 GB of system memory, providing 20 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 320 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage configurations.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate strong multi-core capabilities, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score of 96,293.69 and a Passmark CPU score of 85,426.66. The Intel Xeon processors excel in extended instruction execution, scoring 117,918.35 in Passmark's extended instructions test, aided by hardware-level support for AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Memory performance is highly competitive, reaching a top-tier read-only small block bandwidth of 7,649.82 GB/sec. For language model tasks, the hardware achieves top-tier inference speeds, processing 10,308.98 tokens per second for prompts and generating 377.14 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model.

Given the high-density hardware profile combining four enterprise-grade H100 GPUs and nearly a terabyte of system memory, this instance offers high resource density for specialized workloads. The lack of local storage represents a structural tradeoff, shifting storage performance dependencies to network-attached volumes. This server is optimized for large-scale artificial intelligence workloads, including LLM training and inference, deep learning, high-performance computing, and complex parallel simulations.
description: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a high-density GPU-accelerated server designed for intensive parallel computing. It features 48 physical Intel Xeon 8462Y+ cores operating at 2.0 GHz, paired with 960 GB of system memory. The primary computational power comes from four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with a total of 320 GB VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage solutions. Benchmark data shows top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, multi-threaded decompression, and LLM inference processing. The CPU architecture includes advanced vector and matrix extensions (AVX-512 and AMX), which significantly accelerate mathematical operations. This server is engineered for demanding workloads such as large language model training, deep learning, and complex scientific simulations.
